name: Sharh Mushkil al-Athar
author: Imam Abu Ja'far al-Tahawi
intro: Sharh Mushkil al-Athar of Imam Abu Ja'far al-Tahawi (d. 321 AH) addresses hadiths that appear to contradict one another or reason, reconciling them through careful analysis of chains, wording, and context. It is a landmark of early hadith hermeneutics and a window into Hanafi legal reasoning.
intro_urdu: امام ابو جعفر طحاوی (متوفی 321ھ) کی شرح مشکل الآثار بظاہر مشکل اور متعارض نظر آنے والی تقریباً 7250 احادیث و آثار کی وضاحت پر مشتمل عظیم کتاب ہے۔ اس میں مصنف سند و متن کا جائزہ لے کر ہر باب میں اشکال دور کرتے اور احکام مستنبط کرتے ہیں۔
translation_note: The Arabic is the original text. The Urdu and English translations come from the open Hadith API (Toon) dataset and haven't been checked against a published translation — some are machine-translated, so rely on the Arabic for exact wording.
